file_type: PE32+ (x86-64) console executable, MinGW-w64/GCC 13 built, stripped (external PDB ref), 10 sections, no resources

injection_details.entry_point: WinMain at 0x14000194b (reached from MinGW main wrapper at 0x140002cf0)
injection_details.method: Process forking / 'Ghost Process Hollowing': OpenProcess(PROCESS_CREATE_PROCESS=0x80) on self -> NtCreateProcess(ParentProcess=self handle, DesiredAccess=0x1FFFFF) to create a cloned/forked child process object (never started via CreateProcess, no image on disk) -> NtAllocateVirtualMemory (MEM_COMMIT|MEM_RESERVE 0x3000, PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE 0x40) -> NtWriteVirtualMemory -> NtCreateThreadEx(access 0x1FFFFF, start=allocated base) -> NtResumeThread -> WaitForSingleObject(hThread, 5000) -> NtClose(thread), NtClose(process)
injection_details.target_process: A clone/fork of the malware's own process (no external victim process; child inherits the parent's address space via NtCreateProcess)
injection_details.target_discovery: GetCurrentProcessId() then OpenProcess(PROCESS_CREATE_PROCESS, FALSE, pid) to obtain a handle to itself used as ParentProcess for NtCreateProcess
injection_details.payload_write: NtWriteVirtualMemory of the 64-byte XOR-decrypted shellcode buffer (decrypted on the injector's stack) into RWX memory allocated in the child process
injection_details.apis_resolved_dynamically: ntdll.dll: NtQueryInformationProcess, NtCreateProcess, NtAllocateVirtualMemory, NtWriteVirtualMemory, NtCreateThreadEx, NtResumeThread, NtClose (all via GetModuleHandleA("ntdll.dll") + GetProcAddress at helper 0x1400014ef)
injection_details.imported_helpers: KERNEL32: OpenProcess, GetCurrentProcess, GetCurrentProcessId, CloseHandle, WaitForSingleObject, Sleep
injection_details.post_injection: Sleep(2000) then returns 0; returns 0 immediately (no injection) if a debugger is detected

encryption_details.algorithm: Repeating-key (Vigenère-style) byte XOR; decryptor at 0x140001480: buf[i] ^= key[i % keylen], keylen=0x12, len=0x40
encryption_details.key_storage: Hard-coded plaintext ASCII string at .rdata 0x140004000 (it directly abuts "ntdll.dll" and is not NUL-terminated; length 0x12 is passed as an immediate to the XOR routine)

anti_analysis: NtQueryInformationProcess(ProcessDebugPort=7) check: if STATUS_SUCCESS and returned debug port == 0xFFFFFFFF -> debugger detected (function 0x14000153a)
NtQueryInformationProcess(ProcessDebugFlags=0x1F) check: if STATUS_SUCCESS and flags == 0 -> debugger detected
Anti-debug is executed first in WinMain; on detection the program returns 0 silently without decrypting or injecting (no error message, benign-looking execution)
Payload strings/shellcode kept XOR-encrypted in .data so no meaningful strings/IOCs are visible statically
Sensitive ntdll APIs are resolved at runtime by name (GetModuleHandleA + GetProcAddress) instead of being listed in the import table, so IAT shows only benign KERNEL32/msvcrt imports
Payload is decrypted only into a stack buffer (never stored decrypted in the image), then immediately written to the child process
Binary is compiled stripped (symbols/debug info removed, external PDB reference)
